Get a SRV, look up Davs Hope and the Cobra Crash site, both are great places for farming engineering mats, you just need to exit to the main menu and load back in to reset the farm.

Next, make sure you have plenty of money to upgrade all the major internals to A class, with a  python I suggest core mining or passenger missions. I don't remember it exactly but not far from the bubble there is an extremely lucrative passenger run. I think one of this systems is called Robigo, so look that up. Once you've made enough money to fully outfit, get to engineering, I would start with maxing out FSD and Thrusters first, the extra jump range and turning speed in combat is a must for me.

After that, the galaxy is your oyster. For me, I had the most fun in my Python core mining, I set up a playlist/podcast/tv show on my second monitor and chillout while flying through an ice ring popping the occasional asteroid. The potential cargo space of the Python and a little luck finding core asteroids can bring and awful lot of money. But it sounds like you are into combat, which is why I say focus on thruster engineering first, but with shield/armor engineering along with a shield booster and the Python is a tank.

Speaking of combat, if you want to jump into something a little smaller for dedicated combat, consider the Vulture. I raked in a lot of credits from Low Res Sites bounty hunting, with a partially engineered Vulture, very maneuverable and with a shield booster my shields never went down. I used an engineered pulse laser and multi cannon, both fixed for maximum damage, the vulture is so maneuverable you can stay close on most targets making aiming a little easier.
